info.name: JobLoom — Stored XSS Job Description Test
info.description:
Tests whether jobs.description is stored without sanitising HTML/script, then retrieved unchanged.

Postman can prove STORAGE. Postman cannot prove BROWSER EXECUTION (alert / document.title / bold rendering).

## Verified against current source
| Item | Confirmed value | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Update endpoint | `PUT /api/jobs/:id` (employer, own jobs) | `job.routes.js:87-94` |
| Description on update | allowed field; assigned as-is | `job.service.js` `JOB_UPDATE_FIELDS` includes `description`; lines 643-646 |
| Validation | length >= 20 only; no HTML deny-list | `job.validation.js:188-192` |
| Sanitizer on jobs | **none** (no DOMPurify / sanitize-html) | backend job module |
| Public read | `GET /api/jobs/:id` has **no** `protect` | `job.routes.js:75-81` |
| Frontend render | `parse(job.description)` with `html-react-parser` | `PublicJobDetails.jsx:12,335` and `JobDetails.jsx:4,287` |
| TipTap UI | editor may escape typed HTML — send via **API** | `CreateJob.jsx` / `EditJob.jsx` |

## What Postman can conclude
| Outcome | Wording to use |
| --- | --- |
| Tags stored literally in GET `data.description` | **Unsanitized HTML/script is stored.** Code analysis indicates Stored XSS. **Manual browser confirmation is pending.** |
| Tags escaped (`<b>`) or stripped | Storage path is **not** injecting HTML as stored markup |
| Alert / tab title | **Not observable in Postman.** Capture M3-V9-05 / 06 / 07 in the browser. |

Do not write "Confirmed Stored XSS" until the alert runs in the browser.

## Run order
00 → 01 → 02 → 03 → 04 → 05 → 06 → 07
Then open `{{frontendJobUrl}}` for Stage A (bold) and Stage B (alert).

request.description:
## STAGE B stored-read (screenshot M3-V9-04)

Unauthenticated GET. If `data.description` contains the raw `<script>` block, the payload is **stored**.

That is **not** yet "Confirmed Stored XSS". Confirmation requires the job page to execute it:

Job page loads → description retrieved → `html-react-parser` `parse()` → script mounted → alert + `document.title`.

React does not always run `<script>` nodes created through `html-react-parser`. If the alert does **not** appear, keep the honest wording and still submit the storage evidence + HTML-injection screenshots.
